body:
So went with testing this and only now noticed that `MENU_OPTION_CURSOR_BACK_ROTATE_{X|Y|Z}` cases I've mentioned previously are actually a dead code currently, as the editor shortcuts for them were removed in #96922 (cc @Nodragem). That's a regression, they should be readded (I doubt they were intentionally removed, makes no sense UX-wise to not allow to rotate the other way). But that's for a separate PR (which should be included in 4.4 to avoid a regression).

---

This PR looks good to me. :+1:

Note that when you got a selection and you'll swap to a paint mode, then:
- before this PR rotating would directly affect the to-be-drawn mesh,
- with this PR rotating would still be affecting the selection. You'd need to additionally deselect (RMB) for the rotations to affect the to-be-drawn mesh. But this seems fine/acceptable to me. :thinking:
